title: A $50,000 club fee, and it's not for the club
description: A top-tier private members' club charges tens of thousands of dollars just to join, and tens of thousands more every year to stay in. The dining room and the bar lose money on almost every meal they serve. The fee was never really paying for either of those.

scenes.narration: This club turns away most people who can pay.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up on a heavy brass door pull and polished brass kick plate set into a solid dark walnut door of the most exclusive private members' club in the city, a crisp white cotton glove with a glinting gold cufflink at the wrist resting on the handle, the door open just a crack revealing a warm golden glow and a soft blurred marble hallway beyond, a rough-cut charcoal stone door surround filling the top third of the frame in shadow, honey-toned marble threshold glowing underfoot in bright daylight, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Getting in starts with an initiation fee of fifty thousand dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: A heavy sterling silver fountain pen laid diagonally across a closed bespoke cream leather portfolio with a discreet blind-embossed monogram, a white-gloved concierge's hand with a gold cufflink at the crisp shirt cuff setting it precisely square, shot from a low raking angle across a polished walnut reception desk inside the most exclusive private members' club in the city, the portfolio catching a sliver of warm midday sunlight while most of it falls into soft shadow, a dark wood-panelled wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Then come annual dues of another twenty thousand, whether you ever visit or not.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty round dining table set for one inside the dining room of the most exclusive private members' club in the city, a heavily starched white damask cloth, fine bone china and a full canteen of sterling silver flatware precisely aligned, a folded linen napkin secured with a silver ring, warm daylight falling across the table from a tall window, a dark coffered ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: The dining room and the bar still lose money on almost every meal served.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro close-up of a single white-gloved hand in a crisp shirt cuff and onyx cufflink, holding a cut-crystal tumbler on the mahogany counter of the most exclusive private members' club in the city, a folded white linen cloth beside it, the frame filled edge to edge by the hand, glass and counter with no torso or body visible at all, rows of backlit cut-crystal decanters blurred on a dark shelf behind, warm daylight spilling in from a tall side window, a dark timber ceiling beam filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: So the money was never really paying for the food, or the room.
scenes.imagePrompt: A quiet library lounge inside the most exclusive private members' club in the city, warm daylight, two deep cognac-leather wingback chairs beside an unlit marble fireplace, a crystal tumbler resting on a leather-topped side table, tall bookshelves glowing amber in soft shadow, a shaft of sunlight crossing a herringbone parquet floor, a dark plaster ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: It pays a committee whose entire job is deciding who does not belong.
scenes.imagePrompt: The committee room of the most exclusive private members' club in the city, a long dark walnut table set with a row of closed leather folders, sterling silver inkwells and fountain pens under warm daylight, an empty high-backed leather chair at the head, floor-to-ceiling curtains framing a bright window, a dark coffered ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Membership works less like a purchase and more like a background check with a price attached.
scenes.imagePrompt: A pair of manicured hands in a crisp white shirt cuff with a gold cufflink, reviewing a thick cream reference folder at a polished mahogany partners' desk inside the membership office of the most exclusive private members' club in the city, warm afternoon sunlight falling across the paper, a dark leather-bound ledger and a sterling silver letter opener stacked beside it, a dark wood-panelled wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: The fee was never admission. It is the club paying to keep the wrong people out.
